game_title: Guess Until Right – Spider Den Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Spider Den, a webbed spider den: the shadow ranger must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Guess Until Right: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints.
theme: Shadow Cave – Spider Den: a webbed spider den
core_gameplay_loop: In Spider Den, repeat each round: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints. Each round, rock golems strike the stone seal, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the guess_range value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the stone seal from rock golems in Spider Den: keep the guess_range meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 31-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: guess_range drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 31-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Guess Until Right
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guess_range changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rock golems in Spider Den.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 31 seconds while guess_range > 0.
